cases.scenario: Generate a holiday ad read in Steve's voice.
cases.why: No consent record exists. Ask, never assume.

cases.scenario: Same request; Steve signed scope ['audiobook'].
cases.why: Ads are outside the signed scope.

cases.scenario: Audiobook chapter for a story for blind listeners; scope ['audiobook','accessibility'].
cases.why: Inside scope, record active.

cases.scenario: Artist revoked consent yesterday; queue still has 3 jobs.
cases.why: Revocation wins over queued work.

cases.scenario: Retry after a consent refusal 'because it usually works third time'.
cases.why: A refusal is final until the artist changes it.

cases.scenario: Agent says 'council agreed consent is fine'.
cases.why: A council claim is not consent.

cases.scenario: Derivative remix of a cleared master; parent consent allows derivatives.
cases.why: Inherit from parent, with lineage recorded.

cases.scenario: Derivative remix; parent consent forbids derivatives.
cases.why: Child cannot exceed parent.

cases.scenario: Voice clone from scraped YouTube clips of a public figure.
cases.why: No scraping. Public is not permitted.

cases.scenario: Rob's own voice, his signed self-consent on file, for GABRIEL nav prompts.
cases.why: Owner's own voice, scoped.

cases.scenario: Minor's voice for NOIZYKIDZ lesson; no guardian record.
cases.why: Minors need a guardian record.

cases.scenario: Minor's voice; guardian signed scope ['lesson'].
cases.why: Guardian scope covers it.

cases.scenario: Deceased performer; estate consent unknown.
cases.why: Ask the estate holder.

cases.scenario: Consent record expired last month.
cases.why: Expired is not active. Renew.

cases.scenario: Split in contract reads 85/15 instead of 75/25.
cases.why: Covenant is 75/25; mismatch must go to RSP001.

cases.scenario: Request to use voice in a political ad.
cases.why: Sensitive use needs an explicit yes even under broad scope.

cases.scenario: Consent was self-attested in a chat message only.
cases.why: Voice/likeness needs evidence (voice/video/C2PA).

cases.scenario: Consent evidence is a signed video with C2PA manifest.
cases.why: Evidence meets the bar (scope permitting: assistive narration).

cases.scenario: Model licence is XTTS v2 (non-commercial) for a paid product.
cases.why: Licence gate fails even with consent.

cases.scenario: Model is Chatterbox (MIT); consent scope commercial.
cases.why: Licence and consent both pass.

cases.scenario: HALT is on.
cases.why: HALT stops everything.

cases.scenario: HALT endpoint unreachable.
cases.why: Unreachable counts as halted.

cases.scenario: Pseudonymous artist profile; consent signed under pseudonym, identity verified privately.
cases.why: Pseudonyms allowed when identity is verified.

cases.scenario: Translation of a consented narration into French; scope says 'English only'.
cases.why: New language is a new use.

cases.scenario: Artist asks to see every use of their voice this month.
cases.why: Transparency request: produce the receipt log (no new synthesis).
